name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
title: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd - 500245 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Pig iron volumes fell 3% in Q4 and Hiriyur BF was idle 3.5 months, but management sees pig iron prices recovering (+INR4,000/t since December) and targets 1.85 lakh t castings in FY27.

utilisation.quote: we are at 4,200 last quarter against 6,000 tons, I would say this is about 70%

capex.quote: it would be part of our capex plan of about INR600 crores, INR700 crores per year

triggers.label: Pig iron prices up INR4,000/t since Dec
triggers.quote: pig iron prices are up INR4,000

triggers.label: Solapur casting utilisation ~70%
triggers.quote: we are at 4,200 last quarter against 6,000 tons, I would say this is about 70%

triggers.label: Hiriyur BF idle ~3.5 months in FY26
triggers.quote: stoppage of Hiriyur blast furnace for almost 3.5 months because of the market conditions not being conducive

triggers.label: Casting FY27 target 1.85 lakh t
triggers.quote: 1,85,000 kind of n umber remains our target

guidance.quote: 1,80,000, 1,85,000, 1,90,000 is the numbers we look forward
I expect that we are just above 12.5% of EBITDA
we should bring in around 10% to 11% volumetric growth
I definitely look for ward that we should succeed in getting at least 15% growth once again

guidance.value: 35 MW solar and 25 MW wind by Aug-Sep 2026
guidance.quote: we are pushing hard to commission another 35 megawatts of solar power plant by July, August

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our effort to grow 20%, 25% are not realistic.

red_flags.label: Solapur ramp-up slow; 'ticklish'
red_flags.quote: Solapur is ticklish and we are at 4,200

red_flags.label: Casting target cut from 20-25% to 15%
red_flags.quote: Our effort to grow 20%, 25% are not realistic.

red_flags.label: Management could not answer EBITDA/other-expense question
red_flags.quote: I need to come back. I don't have ready numbers.

evasions.topic: EBITDA margin trajectory and other expenses
evasions.quote: I need to come back. I don't have ready numbers. I didn't look from that angle.
Right now I don't have the figure of what is the pending orders right now.
